## SOPs

| SOP | Status | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| [**capability-spot**](../02_Workflows/SOPs/capability-spot/SOP.md) | beta | End of a week or milestone, after three or more session snapshots or run records accumulate, or on demand |
| [**optimization-loop**](../02_Workflows/SOPs/optimization-loop/SOP.md) | beta | A ranked item in 00_Agentic-OS/OPTIMIZATION-BACKLOG.md, an initiative cycle, or a plug-in improvement is ready to work |
| [**session-snapshot**](../02_Workflows/SOPs/session-snapshot/SOP.md) | beta | A working session is wrapping up, context pressure is rising, or a milestone is reached |
| [**skill-refine**](../02_Workflows/SOPs/skill-refine/SOP.md) | beta | A capability repeatedly under-performs (a failing eval, a recurring lint finding, or a repeated reviewer frown in run records), or alongside a periodic capability review |
| [**workflow-audit**](../02_Workflows/SOPs/workflow-audit/SOP.md) | beta | Weekly, or the moment the same manual sequence has been run three or more times |

## Plug-in skills

None: no plug-in is pinned in this repository.

## Plug-ins

Add one with `python3 06_Engine/scripts/agency.py plugin add <name>`; see [PLUGINS.md](../00_README/PLUGINS.md). List a mounted plug-in's skills, agents and commands with `python3 06_Engine/scripts/agency.py plugin status <name>`.

| Plug-in | Kind | In this repository | Editions | What it adds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **anthropic-skills** | skills | available | upstream | Anthropic's published example skills. The host wires only the Apache-2.0 skills the bundled engines bind (frontend design, web artifacts, web-app testing, brand guidelines, skill creation). The repos… |
| **fde-design-toolkit** | skills | available | full, public | Forward-deployed design skills for engagement work, from discovery to ship. The public edition carries 12 skills; the full edition adds 68 skills, five reviewer agents, Claude commands and gates. |
| **impeccable** | skills | available | upstream | Third-party design fluency for frontend work: one skill with polish, audit and critique commands and curated anti-pattern detection. Wired from the publisher's own Claude plug-in manifest. |
| **prototype-design** | engine | available | standalone | Local, domain-agnostic graph engine that turns an authorized brief into a verified prototype: 19 nodes, eight phases, task packets, browser checks, bounded rework and named human gates. |
| **ui-ux-pro-max** | skills | available | upstream | Third-party UI/UX design intelligence (styles, palettes, font pairings, charts, stack guidance). Wired from the publisher's own Claude plug-in manifest. |
| **video-production** | engine | available | standalone | Deterministic, file-based governance for AI-assisted product-demo films: 25 nodes, measured media, source grounding, six reviews, surgical rework and named human approvals. |
| **video-shotcraft** | skills | available | upstream | Third-party skill for cinematic product videos with Remotion: shot recipes, motion previews, reusable components, sound effects and a production template. The repository is one skill. |
